mapper.insert: insert into material_bill (bill_no, bill_type, operator_id, remark, bill_time, create_time, status, update_time) values (#{billNo},#{billType},#{operatorId},#{remark},#{billTime},#{createTime},#{status},#{updateTime})
mapper.select:
select * from material_bill
bill_no like concat('%',#{billNo},'%')
AND bill_type = #{billType}
order by create_time desc
select b.*,i.id item_id,i.bill_id,i.material_id,i.operate_num from material_bill b left join material_bill_item i on b.id = i.bill_id where b.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mb.id) AS monthOutCount, IFNULL(SUM(mbi.operate_num),0) AS monthOutTotal FROM material_bill mb LEFT JOIN material_bill_item mbi ON mb.id = mbi.bill_id WHERE mb.bill_type = 2 AND mb.status = 1 AND DATE_FORMAT(mb.bill_time,'%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m')

SELECT m.material_name AS name, SUM(mbi.operate_num) AS value FROM material_bill mb LEFT JOIN material_bill_item mbi ON mb.id = mbi.bill_id LEFT JOIN material m ON mbi.material_id = m.id WHERE mb.bill_type = 2 AND mb.status = 1 GROUP BY m.material_name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_bill WHERE bill_type = 2 AND status = 0
